name: Voidek SERP Schema Builder
author: Voidekdev

sections.description:
This plugin helps you manage and enhance product schema on your WooCommerce store. It includes support for dynamic product data, variations, stock updates, multiple images, and aggregate ratings.

Features

– Dynamic Product Data Integration
– Support for Product Variations
– Automatic Stock Availability Updates
– Multiple Product Images in Schema
– Aggregate Ratings and Reviews
– Property selectivity in the admin dashboard
– Dynamic generation of schema
– Admin control of schema topics

Source Code

This plugin does not use any build tools (such as npm, composer, webpack) to generate its production code.
The plugin includes minified JavaScript and CSS for production use.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings in the WordPress Admin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any theme?

Yes, it works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No, it is optimized for performance and only generates schema data when needed.

Can I disable certain schema properties?

Yes, you can control property selection from the admin dashboard.
